description.text: The last Platinum set, released on 4 November 2009 with 111 cards: 99 numbered, nine Arceus numbered AR1 to AR9, one for each Energy type, and three Shiny holos, SH10 to SH12, which made it the first set with two subsets. Arceus, the last fourth-generation Pokémon, made its debut with a rule that lets a deck hold any number of Arceus, and three Arceus LV.X; Gengar, Salamence and Tangrowth are its other Pokémon LV.X. Its theme decks are Flamemaster and Stormshaper. HeartGold & SoulSilver dropped Pokémon LV.X and SP after it.
